##Delegated Investment Decisions: Experimental and Register Data

**Martin Holmén, Felix Holzmeister, Michael Kirchler, Matthias Stefan, Erik Wengström**

In this study, we combine online experiments with register data of 
participants from a sample of Swedish financial professionals and a 
representative sample of the Swedish general population. Statistiska 
centralbyrån (SCB; Statistics Sweden) will invite subjects for the 
online experiment and provide a set of predefined variables of the
subjects’ register data for those who completed the experiment. 

With this project, we aim at examining motivations and preferences 
that shape both the choice of private investors to delegate financial 
decisions and professionals’ decisions made on behalf of others.

The project has been preregistered at https://osf.io/uma9z/. A 
detailed description of the experimental design is available via 
https://osf.io/xmkt8/. 

Demo versions of the experiment and all  treatments (in English) 
are available via http://hea-2019-01-en.herokuapp.com.
